connects_to.relationship: NVIDIA made a direct investment in Lumentum; Lumentum supplies ultra-high-power laser chips and OCS for NVIDIA CPO switches

contracts.signal: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston said the discussions with NVIDIA 'have emerged with, one, a very substantial long-term agreement that we’ve characterized as a multibillion-dollar deal, and then, of course, the investment where they helped us considerably buy that fab and equip it and outfit it' (the Greensboro fab he had just described). He added that 'it was a year cycle for us to get qualified at Nvidia', and that before investing in more capacity for NPO customers he would 'need to see a similar type of commitment as we ultimately got from Nvidia.'
contracts.type: long-term supply agreement + investment funding the Greensboro fab
